info.name: Go Server: App API (v1)
info.description:
Everything the app calls on the Go Server, under `/app/v1`, in the app contract's section order. Generated by `pnpm postman:build` from the routes' own metadata (src/api/v1): do not edit by hand.

Sign in with a Supabase access token: `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` (the collection's auth). Locally, `pnpm dev:stack` runs a fake Supabase Auth: `GET {{authUrl}}/mint?name=Priya&email=priya@gmail.com` gives a token.

Every write may carry an `Idempotency-Key` (one per press; the same one on a retry replays the first answer). Errors always look like `{"error": {"code", "message", "field", "retry_after_seconds", "request_id"}}`. Money is whole paise. Full reference: docs/API.md.

request.description: Your own profile: name, photo, email, sign-in provider, UPI id, default city, notifications switch.
Change your name, photo link, UPI id, default "travelling from" or the notifications switch. Strict body, at least one field.

A short-lived link to the person's vault page in Go, for the browser sheet.

Joins the trip with the join answers (from_city, earliest_leave, know, budget). Safe to repeat.

from_city, earliest_leave (null clears), know ([] clears). Go hears only what differs, in this trip.

Messages posted or changed after a change number (?after_seq=&limit=), oldest change first, with has_more.
text and/or attachments; reply_to, about_message_id ("Ask Go about this"), mentions. client_id or an Idempotency-Key makes a retry safe.

Your entries from the fewest-payments list: you_pay (with the payee's UPI id) and owed_to_you (with nudge_allowed_at). no-store.
{ from_person_id }: remind someone who owes you. One per person per trip every 24 hours (429 with Retry-After).

The facts Go holds about you, where each came from, and the carry-over switch.
{ carry_over: true|false }: remember me in future trips (off by default).

request.description: Delete one thing Go knows about you. 404 when Go has no such fact.
Go forgets you in one trip (?trip_id=) or everywhere; the server clears your join answers there too. Never claims success when Go did not answer.
